tasks.short: Conduct recreational and athletic activities within qualifications

steps.what: Conduct therapeutic, recreational, or athletic activities within authorised scope

tasks.design: Keep activity delivery with the qualified instructor and use authorised plans in {DOCS} as references. No software change reduces supervision, demonstration or response time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Delivery is an interactive physical activity rather than a document transformation.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability removes the need for live instruction.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to discomfort, differing abilities and changing participation.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor notices problems and can stop or alter an activity immediately.
tasks.altitude: Time and delivery responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Activity boundaries and escalation of concerns

evidence.claim: Live physical activity delivery retains direct instruction and response effort; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is live activity delivery; advance planning is separate. The occupational wording grants no clinical therapy authority.
Instructor produces activity responses in s1; no structured participant assessment or automated intervention is assumed.
Check native plan-reference tools before custom development.
No new tool or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Instructor qualifications and permitted therapeutic scope
research_questions: Which activity situations require referral or a pause rather than a different instruction aid?

already_counted.description: Live activity delivery and participant response

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero net saving. Routine and difficult activities both retain live delivery time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan physical education for physical and social development

steps.what: Plan physical education programs for physical attributes and social skills
Document and check the chosen physical education programme

tasks.design: Reuse a programme-plan structure in {DOCS} after the instructor selects content. Configuration reduces repeated layout and standard-heading entry while the instructor retains developmental judgement and checks the completed plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programme decisions are repeatedly written into the same document structure.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable sections and tables can reduce formatting without generating exercise choices.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing physical goals, social participation, progression and individual limitations.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor can judge whether a technically valid plan is inclusive and workable for this group.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in document assembly; planning authority stays unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare programme materials from instructor-approved selections
reach.learn: Preserving progression, accessibility and escalation instructions

evidence.claim: Reusable document structures can reduce programme formatting after professional content selection; this fitness scenario is not measured.
Teachmate drafts early-years activity ideas and observation drafts; that does not establish fitness programme suitability or time savings.

assumptions: Boundary is programme planning, not live instruction or separate routine-sheet assembly. Overlapping documentation must be assigned once in a roll-up.
Instructor in s1 produces goals, selected activities, progression, duration, equipment, participation adaptations and stop/escalation instructions. Its full 80 hours include capture and selection.
Retained s2 time includes entering current details, checking meaning and manually handling missing fields. Template reuse adds no inferred participant capability or health status.
Test native document reuse before custom code. Existing templates earn no saving; only newly removed repetition is counted.
unknowns: Current formatting burden and native reuse options
research_questions: Can a reused structure preserve selected content and progression while reducing assembly time?

already_counted.description: Needs interpretation, content decisions and capture
Current entries, meaning checks and manual exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain document defaults and correct reuse errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact programme document with goals, activities, progression, durations, adaptations and escalation instructions; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=80+12=92 give gross 8; less 2 upkeep gives net 6. High requires repeated document assembly; low assumes only 2 hours removable in mostly bespoke plans, consumed by upkeep. Content judgement retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach sports through instruction and demonstration

steps.what: Teach individual and team sports through instruction and demonstration

tasks.design: Retain sports instruction, demonstration and practice checks with the instructor. Existing technique guidance in {DOCS} remains a preparation aid without reducing the live teaching allocation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participants need feedback on their actual practice, not just access to instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital reference availability does not remove demonstration and adaptation effort.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining technique at the right level and managing safe, fair group participation.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor can notice misunderstanding, demonstrate differently and adjust the activity.
tasks.altitude: No change to teaching time or responsibility.

reach.task: Support supervised practice of a demonstrated technique
reach.learn: Safe practice boundaries and when to involve the instructor

evidence.claim: Live sports instruction requires demonstration and participant response checks; no incremental software saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is live sports teaching; planning and attendance administration are separate tasks.
Instructor produces instruction and adjusts it from observed response; no machine-readable capability score is required.
Native reference tools should be checked before any future custom tool.
No new service or maintained dataset is introduced, justifying zero upkeep.
unknowns: Sport mix, group size and instructor qualifications
research_questions: Which teaching difficulties need individual demonstration rather than additional digital material?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero saving. Both familiar and new techniques retain live instruction time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Promote health-club membership and record member information

steps.what: Promote health clubs and discuss membership choices with prospective members
Record member information and the chosen membership
Check member information and save the agreed membership record

tasks.design: Configure one membership-entry form in {CRM} so selected plan fields populate from the existing authorised membership list. The instructor still explains terms, captures member details and checks the exact record; marketing consent is separate from membership acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plan details and contact fields are repeated across notes and the member record.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and selectable authorised plans can avoid repeated typing without changing the sales conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining terms honestly and recognising when a membership is unsuitable for a person's needs.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor can answer questions, avoid pressure and correct misunderstandings before recording a choice.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated member entry; no new power to vary prices, terms or consent.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of personal service workers
reach.task: Review membership-entry exceptions and misleading default selections
reach.learn: Consent separation, authorised terms and correction procedures

evidence.claim: Native records forms can reuse authorised plan fields and reduce duplicate membership entry; the time allocation is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is promotion and recording a membership choice, not payment collection, automated marketing or fitness assessment.

Instructor in retained s2 captures name, contact details, selected plan identifier, start date, accepted terms version and separately expressed marketing choice. Existing authorised plan list supplies plan name, duration, price and terms reference; list checking is included in upkeep.
No new customer data-entry burden is introduced: member-provided details are collected by the instructor within retained capture time. Unknown fields are entered manually or left explicitly pending.
S3 checks identity, chosen plan, dates and expressed permissions before save. No default consent, auto-enrolment or external contract action is introduced.
Test native form configuration before custom code. Existing auto-population earns no savings; benefit requires observed duplicate entry.
unknowns: Current duplicate entry and native membership features
Who authorises plan changes and applicable membership terms
research_questions: Can a single form remove repeated entry without increasing wrong-plan records or consent errors?

incremental.description: Check authorised plan defaults, field changes and access exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact member record with identity, contact, chosen plan, start date, terms version and separately expressed marketing preference; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=60+15+15=90 give gross 10, less 2 upkeep gives net 8. High requires duplicate entry in s2; low assumes only 2 hours removed in an already integrated process, consumed by upkeep. Promotion and final checks retain all time.
